integrity: The infinite theorem is proved algebraically. Exact-arithmetic code is included only as a consistency check of the formulas and a concrete replay of the formerly open \(n=5,k=2\) case.
scientific_limitations: Specific to real \(\ell_1^n\), with pairwise distinctness asserted for primal vectors but not for norming functionals. No classification, uniqueness, or extension to arbitrary real Banach spaces is claimed. An obscure or unindexed equivalent construction remains a residual literature risk.
title: Distinct-vector FUNTFs of every length \(n+1,\ldots,2n\) in real \(\ell_1^n\)
